code:
import {ColorArea, ColorPicker, ColorSlider, ColorSwatch, Label} from "@lenso/ui";

export function CustomStyles() {
  return (
    <ColorPicker defaultValue="#0485F7">
      <ColorPicker.Trigger className="rounded-xl bg-default-soft px-3 py-2">
        <ColorSwatch size="lg" />
        <Label className="font-medium text-foreground">主题色</Label>
      </ColorPicker.Trigger>
      <ColorPicker.Popover className="bg-surface">
        <ColorArea
          aria-label="颜色区域"
          className="max-w-full"
          colorSpace="hsb"
          xChannel="saturation"
          yChannel="brightness"
        >
          <ColorArea.Thumb />
        </ColorArea>
        <ColorSlider channel="hue" className="gap-1 px-1" colorSpace="hsb">
          <Label>色相</Label>
          <ColorSlider.Output className="text-muted" />
          <ColorSlider.Track>
            <ColorSlider.Thumb />
          </ColorSlider.Track>
        </ColorSlider>
      </ColorPicker.Popover>
    </ColorPicker>
  );
}
